project_type: Python Flask web app - real-time drone crack detection system
test_framework: Custom integration test script: python tests/test_integration.py (no pytest)
build_command: pip install -r requirements.txt (after torch CPU install)
verification_instructions: 1. Create venv and install deps. 2. Run python tests/test_integration.py. 3. Verify all modules import without errors. 4. Verify Flask endpoints return expected status codes.
setup_instructions: python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu -q && pip install -r requirements.txt -q
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. mesa-libGL already installed. No actual MediaMTX server or drone available - validation is structural/import-based. venv already exists at /projects/sandbox/Matanglawin-2.0/venv/
contribution_requirements: Do NOT break existing features. Preserve existing architecture. Only replace the video acquisition pipeline. Keep existing crack detection, validation, capture, inspection, PDF, CSV, inspection history functional.
key_patterns: VideoSource class interface (open/read/release/is_open). Detector uses registry dict of SourceSpec. CaptureManager state machine. annotate_frame() returns 4-tuple. inspection_db uses SQLite WAL. report_generator uses fpdf2. Frontend polls /status and /capture/status.
